related_information: If any failure code is displayed, perform troubleshooting for that code first.

steps.point_to_check: If fuel tank is checked, it is empty.

steps.cause: Clogging fuel tank cap air bleeding hole
steps.point_to_check: Fuel tank cap air bleeding hole is clogged.
steps.remedy: Flush air breather hole in fuel tank cap surrounding area.

steps.point_to_check: Check used hours of fuel filter element. If it is used over specified time, fuel filter element may be clogged.

steps.cause: Foreign materials are mixed into fuel.
steps.point_to_check: If drain fuel from fuel tank, rust or water comes out.

steps.cause: Air mixed in fuel piping system
steps.point_to_check: When performing bleeding air from the fuel system, air comes out. (For details, see Testing and Adjusting, “Bleed Air from Fuel System”).
steps.remedy: • Perform air bleeding operation • Correct or replace fuel piping

steps.point_to_check: Fuel leaks from fuel piping. (For details, see Testing and Adjusting, “Examine Fuel Circuit for Leakage”).
steps.remedy: Correct or replace fuel piping related parts

steps.cause: Fuel leakage at Injector and inlet connector
steps.point_to_check: Return rate from injector is high. (See Testing and Adjusting, “How to Examine Fuel Discharge, Return, and Leakage”)
See Testing and adjusting, “Testing fuel discharge rate, return rate, and leakage”
steps.remedy: Supply pump and pressure limiter replacement

steps.point_to_check: Air cleaner dust indicator is at caution level.
steps.remedy: Air cleaner element check and cleaning

steps.point_to_check: Check air cleaner and wire net for deformation.

steps.cause: Defective air intake hose (air cleaner to turbocharger inlet)
steps.point_to_check: Visually check for damages of air intake hose.
Check for internal damages of air intake manifold.

steps.cause: Defective boost piping and connection (between turbocharger outlet and intake manifold)
steps.point_to_check: Air comes out of boost piping.

steps.cause: Defective installation of charge pressure sensor
steps.point_to_check: Air leakage through mounting portion of charge pressure sensor
steps.remedy: Repair installation of charge pressure sensor

steps.cause: Defective exhaust pipe (between exhaust manifold and muffler inlet)
steps.point_to_check: Check exhaust pipes for damage and exhaust gas leakage (Check heat insulation cover and soot on heat insulation plate)

steps.cause: Check of air intake/ exhaust system (turbocharger outlet, air intake manifold/exhaust manifold, and muffler inlet)
steps.point_to_check: Measure boost pressure (Reference: See Testing and adjusting, “Testing boost pressure”).
• Unusual noise is heard from turbocharger. • Check if turbocharger shaft can rotate (by manually moving the turbocharger's blade axially and vertically).
• When engine is operated, unusual noise is heard from around cylinder head. • Check valve clearance (Reference: See Testing and adjusting, “Testing and adjusting valve clearance”).

• A low-temperature cylinder is found when touching the exhaust manifold right after the engine starts. • A cylinder running at the unchanged speed is found during operation in the cylinder cut-out mode. (Reference: See Testing and Adjusting, “Handle Cylinder Cut-out Mode Operation”.) REMARK If a black smoke is seen continuously during warmup operation after storage for a few days, injector may be defective.
In case of an internal defect, troubleshooting is impossible as an assembly. Replace whole assembly.

steps.cause: Defective contact of valve and valve seat
steps.point_to_check: • Measure compression pressure (See Standard value table). (Reference: See Testing and adjusting, “Testing compression pressure”.) • Check valve clearance (Reference: See Testing and adjusting, “Testing and adjusting valve clearance”).
steps.remedy: Valve or valve seat repair or replacement

steps.point_to_check: • Check exhaust gas color . (See standard value table.) (Reference: See Testing and adjusting, “Exhaust gas color”). • Measure compression pressure (See standard value table). (Reference: See “TESTING AND ADJUSTING”, “Testing compression pressure”.) • Check piston ring and piston ring groove.
